timing_contract.scope: In-memory numeric input through full Amelia result; includes internal PSOCK cluster creation and teardown.
timing_contract.excluded: CSV parsing, quality summaries and JSON writing.
timing_contract.warmup_contract: Warmup runs call the same public API; snow starts a fresh internal cluster on every call.
timing_contract.peak_ram_measurement: Not measured; null does not mean zero.

quality_contract.normalized_rmse: For each imputation, sqrt(mean(((imputed-truth)/truth_column_sample_sd)^2)) across explicitly heldout cells; null if any heldout prediction is nonfinite.
quality_contract.pooling: Column-mean Rubin summaries; within-imputation variance is sample variance divided by each column's nonmissing count. Between/total variance is null for m=1.
quality_contract.missing_rows: Counts rows with at least one remaining missing value, by imputation.
